name: Epigral Limited
summary: Epigral Limited manufactures and sells chlor-alkali and derivative products in India and internationally. The company offers chlorinated polyvinyl chloride (CPVC) resin, epichlorohydrin, chloromethanes value chain, hydrogen peroxide, caustic soda and potash, chlorine, hydrogen, chloromethanes, captive power plant (CPP), and chlorotoluene value chain, as well as operates wind-solar hybrid power plant. Its products are used in CPVC pipes and fittings, windmills, construction, paints and coatings, electronics, water treatment, agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, refineries, soap and detergents, fluoropolymers, paper and pulp, textiles, alumina, polyurethane foam, lithium, and polytetrafluoroethylen…
